levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: One or both emails include slang, an unclear reason, or an abrupt closing that a club leader would find unprofessional.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Both emails are polite, state a clear reason or request, and end with an appropriate closing line.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and both emails read as genuinely warm and specific rather than stiff or copied from a formula.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The round-two email is noticeably weaker than round one, missing required checklist elements once the starters are gone.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The round-two email meets all tone-checklist items without any sentence starters.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the reflection names a specific skill the learner had to supply on their own once the scaffolding was removed.

lookFors: The round-two email suggests one genuinely specific alternative time, not a vague 'whenever works.'
The reflection names a specific missing support, not a general statement that round two was 'harder.'

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
